# TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui

A Discord Activity template using **TailwindCSS** and **shadcn/ui** for beautiful, accessible components.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://ui.shadcn.com/" title="shadcn/ui" description="Beautiful, accessible components." />
  <Card href="https://tailwindcss.com/" title="Tailwind CSS" description="Utility-first CSS framework." />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/react-tailwind-shadcn-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- TailwindCSS pre-configured
- shadcn/ui component library
- Dark mode support
- TypeScript support

## Adding Components

Use the shadcn CLI to add components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button
npx shadcn add card
```

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
